mentions.name: ViewMD
mentions.description: A Mac Markdown viewer app that supports standard Markdown formatting plus diagrams and equations, letting AI coding assistants like Claude produce system documentation that includes visual diagrams of database structures, logic, or AWS services. Available on the Mac App Store.
mentions.problem: There was no simple yet powerful Markdown viewer for the Mac despite Markdown becoming the default format for AI coder docs.
mentions.audience: Developers using AI coding tools to write documentation, who need to view Markdown files with diagrams and equations on Mac
mentions.source_excerpt:
ViewMD - A Mac Markdown Viewer app

It looks like Markdown is having a bit of a heyday with it being the default mode of docs for AI coders. And it became apparent that there is no simple, but powerful Markdown viewer for the Mac, so I made one.
